# Visuals and scale

Soft medieval fantasy: warm, stylised, cosy rather than grim. Final art is stylised low poly, decided later.
The prototype and MVP use coloured placeholder shapes.

## Placeholder colours (flat URP Lit, generated by an Editor script)
| Function | Colour | Hex |
|---|---|---|
| Benches, tables, floor furniture | Brown | `#8B5A2B` |
| Trays, pots, plain plants (base) | Green | `#4CAF50` |
| Water (can, rain barrel) | Blue | `#2F7FD8` |
| Carts and wagons | Yellow | `#F2C230` |
| Buyers | Own colours per guild | — |
| Plants with behaviour | Distinct base colour (Snapjaw: deep magenta `#A0306E`) | — |
| Ground | Muted grass | `#7A9A5A` |
| Buildings (order desk, crate, counter, bed) | Light grey | `#BDBDBD` |
| Ghost valid / invalid | Translucent green / red | `#40FF4080` / `#FF404080` |

- **Placeholder plants show their genes:** tint from the colour gene, size from the growth stage.
- **Mood indicator** above every plant with a Mood module, readable from above and not by colour alone:
  Content = none; Restless = twitch/shake animation + small "!" icon; Acting out = faster shake + red "!!"; Escaped = the plant model on the floor with a trail.
- Wilted plants droop and desaturate; dead plants turn brown-grey `#6E6253`.
- **Readable from above:** silhouettes, colours and mood cues must work from the follow camera, not up close.
- Every placeable is a prefab: behaviour and footprint on the root, swappable placeholder mesh as a child.

## Lighting
URP, basic day–night cycle from the sim clock: warm morning, neutral day, orange evening, blue night (built).

## Scale (first pass)
| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| Floor grid cell | 0.5 × 0.5 m |
| Planting mini-grid unit | 0.1 × 0.1 m |
| Bench planting area | 0.6 m deep, rows by pot size |
| Standard benches | 3 m and 4 m long (depth: `building.md` open point A) |
| Bench top height | 0.9 m |
| Player height | 1.8 m |
| Path width | 1.0 m minimum |
| Smart-targeting reach | 1.5 m |
| Player speed / escaped Snapjaw speed | 3 m/s / 0.5 m/s |
